skill_concept: Migrate domain-specific scientific numerical code across frameworks or languages (MATLAB→NumPy, NEURON→Jaxley) by mapping source numerical semantics and API calls to modern Python equivalents, then validating agreement between reference and ported outputs.
verdict_reason: Both tasks involve porting numerical scientific code to Python, but the procedure shapes diverge significantly: matlab-python-conversion is a straightforward API-mapping exercise (file I/O, array stacking) with a clear numerical equivalence check, while neuron-to-jaxley-conversion requires deep domain knowledge of neuronal biophysics, channel kinetics, and compartmental modeling that goes well beyond framework API translation. A skill written to cover both would need to be so abstract it loses actionable guidance.
weakest_link_reason: This task demands specialized computational neuroscience domain knowledge (HH channels, Ca dynamics, region-specific conductance parameters) that cannot be derived from generic numerical API mapping — it is closer to biophysics implementation than framework migration.
